definition.en: A push or a pull. A force can make a still object move, make a moving object speed up, slow down, stop or change direction, and change an object's shape.
definition.zh: 推或拉。力能使静止的物体运动，使运动的物体加快、减慢、停下或改变方向，还能改变物体的形状。

definition.en: A force that moves or tends to move something away from whatever is pushing it.
definition.zh: 把物体往离开施力者的方向推、或要把它推开的力。

definition.en: A force that moves or tends to move something towards whatever is pulling it.
definition.zh: 把物体往施力者这边拉、或要把它拉过来的力。

definition.en: Not moving. A stationary object can still have forces acting on it, as long as they balance.
definition.zh: 没有在动。静止的物体身上也可以有力，只要这些力互相抵消。

definition.en: Movement: a change of position. A force can make motion faster or slower, stop it or change its direction.
definition.zh: 位置在变。力能使运动变快、变慢、停下，或改变运动的方向。

definition.en: The pull of the Earth on every object, towards the ground. It acts without contact.
definition.zh: 地球对每个物体朝地面方向的拉力，不用接触就能起作用。也叫地心引力。

definition.en: The pull of gravity on an object, measured in newtons with a spring balance. Weight is not the same as mass. In Chinese, weight is 重量; 重力 is the force of gravity.
definition.zh: 重力对物体的拉力，用弹簧秤量，单位是牛顿。重量和质量不同。注意：“重量”是 weight，“重力”是 gravitational force。

definition.en: How much matter an object has, measured in grams or kilograms. It stays the same wherever the object is, even on the Moon.
definition.zh: 物体含有多少物质，用克或千克作单位。物体到哪里质量都不变，到了月球也一样。

definition.en: A force between two surfaces that rub, or are about to rub, against each other. It acts against the motion, or against the start of it.
definition.zh: 两个表面互相擦过、或将要擦过时，两者之间的力。它阻碍运动，或阻碍物体开始运动。

definition.en: The outside layer of an object. Surfaces can be rough or smooth, hard or soft, and these change how much friction there is.
definition.zh: 物体最外面的一层。表面有粗糙有光滑、有硬有软，这些都会影响摩擦力的大小。

definition.en: The force of a stretched or squashed spring as it tries to get back to its own length: a stretched spring pulls back, a squashed one pushes outwards.
definition.zh: 被拉长或压短的弹簧想回到原来长度时产生的力：拉长的弹簧往回拉，压短的弹簧往外推。

definition.en: How much longer a spring is than its own length when it is stretched.
definition.zh: 弹簧被拉长时，比原来的长度多出来的那一段。

definition.en: The push or pull between magnets, and the pull of a magnet on things made of iron or steel. It acts without contact.
definition.zh: 磁铁之间的推或拉，以及磁铁对铁或钢制物品的吸引。它不用接触就能起作用。

definition.en: An instrument that measures a force, such as a pull or a weight, by how far it stretches a spring. Its scale is marked in newtons.
definition.zh: 用弹簧伸长了多少来量力（比如拉力或重量）的器材，刻度以牛顿为单位。

definition.en: The unit of force. In this topic newtons are only read from a spring balance, not worked out.
definition.zh: 力的单位。这一课里只从弹簧秤上读牛顿，不做计算。

definition.en: An experiment in which only one thing is changed at a time and everything else is kept the same, so that any change in the result comes from that one thing.
definition.zh: 一次只改变一样东西、其余都保持不变的实验。这样结果有变化，就知道是那一样东西造成的。
